content:
Maya S: quick standup re: webinar launch + blog + landing. need a tight SEO preflight checklist we can run right before publish: keywords, json-ld, small internal-link audit, redirects, and crm payload mapping. target next monday.

Ravi K: agree. can we commit to 3 primaries + 3 support terms and a meta desc? keep title <=60 chars.

Maya S: primaries: "LLM inference platform", "production LLM serving", "dedicated inference clusters". supports: inference cost optimization, batching strategies, kv cache. i'll draft meta.

Tara L: schema plan: WebPage + Event + 3 faq items. i will paste minimal json-ld for the event into the head and FAQ snippets for the body. sample snippet i'll use: 
```
<script type="application/ld+json">{"@context":"https://schema.org","@type":"Event","name":"Serving LLMs in Prod (Redwood webinar)","startDate":"2024-06-20T17:00:00Z","url":"https://redwood.inference/events/serving-llms"}</script>
```
will also add 3 concise FAQ q/a pulled from the deck.

Devon P: redirect plan: prepare CSV of current pages we want to consolidate -> landing. i'll run 301s the evening after publish. sample rows i'll include: 
```
source,target,code
/old-webinar,/events/serving-llms,301
/blog/2023/llm-inference,/events/serving-llms,301
/docs/inference,/events/serving-llms,301
```
will validate in staging first.

Sadie M: internal-link audit: small PRs to add CTAs from /docs/runtime, /product/features, /resources. anchors: "low-latency serving", "reduce inference cost", "dedicated capacity". i can batch the PRs. also confirm we don't change global nav.

Ravi K: meta desc variant: "Join Redwood's webinar on serving LLMs in production. Learn latency tricks, cost controls, and rollout patterns. Register now." (under 155 chars).

Maya S: inbound routing: utm params + webinar_id in CRM webhook. simple rule: company_size > 50 -> SDR queue, else -> nurture. add `interested_in` SKU field. @Devon confirm keys/format.

Devon P: confirmed. webhook payload will include: email, first_name, last_name, company, company_size (int), utm_source, utm_medium, utm_campaign, webinar_id, interested_in. returns 200 on success. i'll share example curl in staging.

Sadie M: small accessibility note for landing: ensure H1 uses primary keyword and that CTAs have descriptive aria-labels. will add to PR checklist.

Tara L: hero copy A/B for signup modal: A) "Ship LLM features with predictable latency" B) "Cut inference cost while keeping SLAs". run 50/50 for first 1k impressions, measure CTR->signup.

Maya S: timeline: blog draft by fri (1730090000), landing live mon (1730139999), redirect sweep mon night. owners: tara (schema/copy), devon (redirects/webhook), sadie (links/accessibility), ravi (meta/prs), maya (pm).

SEO-bot: Created task MARKETING-4209 "webinar landing SEO + redirects + links" (https://trello.company/board/card/MARKETING-4209).

Maya S: i'll post the draft link in here when ready. any blockers?

Ravi K: none from eng, thanks. :thumbsup:
